name: Century Mold
old_description: Century Mold delivers precision-engineered plastic solutions across North America
about:
Century Mold was founded in 1986 in Shelbyville, Tennessee. The company operates as a U.S.-based manufacturer of precision plastic components, with no public disclosure of its ownership structure or founding individuals.

The company provides fully integrated plastic injection molding services, from part and tool design through production and finishing. Its six North American facilities encompass 675,000 square feet and house more than 200 presses ranging up to 2,200 tons of clamping force. A staff of over 50 engineers, designers, and mold builders supports design-for-manufacturability, Moldflow and finite-element analysis, reverse engineering, scanning, and 3D printing. Secondary operations include assembly, multiple welding methods, pad printing, and performance testing.

Century Mold serves automotive, defense, industrial, consumer, lawn-and-garden, and packaging markets. Automotive customers—including OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers such as BorgWarner, Robert Bosch, Delphi, and Visteon—source complex, high-volume components that appear in over 80 percent of vehicles on U.S. roads. Defense programs rely on the company for mission-critical parts produced under secure, fully controlled U.S. manufacturing. Industrial and consumer clients use its in-house engineering and tool-transfer capabilities to bring products to market.

The company emphasizes a localized supply chain and secure, end-to-end production as key differentiators, citing its IATF 16949 and ISO 9001:2015 certifications and a track record of supplier awards from major automotive OEMs. It positions itself as a partner that reduces risk through tool-transfer expertise and disciplined process control.
